name: Agented
description: A text editor for LLMs, not humans. Optimized for the model's cost model: fewer round trips per task (no   Read-before-Edit; conflict responses carry the new content, so you reconcile in one call instead of  pre-reading every time), tighter token budget (lean tab output, not JSON envelopes; ~5x denser than the  built-in Read/Edit shape), inline LSP diagnostics on every save (gopls, rust-analyzer-with-clippy,  tsserver+eslint findings come back as diag lines instead of round-tripping through cargo / go build),  reactive drift detection (external editor or formatter writes are folded into the undo tree as new  edits, not silently clobbered or lost), and a branching undo tree that remembers the branches the agent  abandoned — because that's often where the interesting work was. Three-way merge for concurrent agents, atomic multi-file refactors, cross-session memory via per-file annotations.

Ships **1 skill**, `agented` (A text editor for LLMs, not humans) and **1 MCP server**, `agented`.

Installs with `claude plugin install agented@claude-community` from `frane/agented` (`plugin`).

Three-way merge for concurrent agents, atomic multi-file refactors, cross-session memory via per-file annotations.
